The efficacy of a 10% formulation of topical caffeine in the treatment of psoriasis has been investigated in a group of 39 patients with stable plaque psoriasis.1 Improvements were seen at each 2-week follow-up stage, but the difference only be- came significant after 8 weeks. The only adverse effect noted during the study was mild itching, reported by 2 of the caffeine recipients. 1. Vali A, et al. Evaluation of the efficacy of topical caffeine in the treatment of psoriasis vulgaris. J Dermatol Treat 2005; 16: 234–7.
